question.text: In a unified onshore-offshore structure, Kaveri Macro Fund's domestic Cat III AIF is distributed at Singapore and Dubai. The supplement attached to the PPM for offshore distribution purposes is called:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.6: 'A wrapper is a supplement attached to the Private Placement Memorandum of the domestic fund distributed at offshore locations (in case of unified structure). This helps to achieve compliance with the requirements for private placement of the securities of an offshore fund to investors in jurisdictions outside India.' The Trap: Option A is the constitutional document. Option C is bilateral, not a supplement for offshore distribution. Option D is fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the wrapper concept in both tracks. XIX-B tests how distributors handle wrapper-equipped PPMs offshore. Manager's Pro-Tip: Draft the wrapper for the SPECIFIC jurisdiction (MAS Singapore, DFSA Dubai, SFC Hong Kong) — private placement carve-outs differ. A single 'global wrapper' typically fails to meet Section 275 (MAS SFA) or DIFC retail-investor exclusions cleanly.
